text: A definition counts as proved at the correct basis when the declaration text of a receipted, eligible (not superseded) emission whose recorded configuration matches is identical (generator norm_decl) to the gate declaration and `@fresh = @gate` is proved against the compiled gate constant. Configuration per emission is read from the PINS/spec env (PCUI_emissions.py, PCUI_EMISSION_CONFIG.json): ON when CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OVERFLOW_CHECKS=true or RUSTFLAGS has overflow-checks=yes; OFF_DEFAULT when the stager ran without an overflow flag (release profile default, no package override in the frozen workspace Cargo.toml for aspis-r1-cost-probe); retained copies (extract-stage, batch-merkle FILE: self-copies) are not a basis. ON emission: counted EQUALITY_PROVED. OFF emission and the gate declaration contains wrapping_* (the gate models plain-operator wrapping): EQUALITY_PROVED at OFF, deployed wrapping stays R22's. OFF emission only and no wrapping_ in the declaration: EQUALITY_PROVED with pcui_basis_note CONFIG_INDEPENDENT_BY_TEXT_OFF_EMISSION_ONLY, counted separately (no ON emission was obtained; the independence argument is lexical: no plain-operator arithmetic, or a Rust const item, which rustc const-evaluates with overflow checking in both configurations). This is an argument, not an ON emission; the lead may demote these 29 to OPEN.

The 119 WRONG_BASIS records came from P5 proofs against retained copies (configuration UNKNOWN). They were not re-labelled: each was re-proved against a fresh emission with a recorded configuration (101) and the old records are listed as superseded in PCUI_ALL_STATUS.json pcui_superseded.

NMH_E010 (NJS_Extract, OFF default) emits Std.U64.wrapping_shl/shr with the amount at its Rust type (8#i32); this does not elaborate against the library (first attempt PCUI_L017: 3 of 34 theorems carried sorryAx from the elaboration error, not credited; the shape was changed, not rerun). The ShrAmt U64 prelude (inputs/prelude_shramt_u64.lean) is the same encoding bridge as PCQH-C2, verified for overflow-checks-OFF only (evidence/shramt-20261110); only 2 credited definitions depend on it and both are OFF-configuration.

TEXT_IDENTICAL_ONLY / TEXT_ONLY_NOT_COMPARED Types records (74 in non-cut modules): 34 inductives with arguments, 29 structures, 8 def types, 3 enums. One generic class was added to the generator (PCUI_gen_equalities.py parse_ctors/emit_ind_equiv): an identical-text parameterless inductive whose constructor arguments mention no type declared in the same file gets Equiv fresh T <-> gate T by constructor-wise match, left_inv/right_inv by `cases x <;> rfl`. Structures with fields of fresh types use the existing structure-equiv class. 33 of 61 records with an identical eligible emission were proved. A record whose Equiv is proved states type isomorphism of two declarations of identical text, not identity of the types; callers that rely on Lean name resolution to the gate type keep that convention.
